verdict.rationale: The Cloud API supports creating runs programmatically (client.runs.create) that execute asynchronously with session persistence and event polling, meaning tasks can run without a human driving the browser live — a core building block for background automation. However there is no documented native scheduling/trigger/cron mechanism for kicking off runs on a timer or event, so 'autonomous background automation' requires external orchestration. missing for 10: built-in scheduler/trigger feature, evidence of long-running unattended jobs, independent confirmation of background reliability.
